EOS ENERGY $EOSE WINS GOLDEN DOME POWER CONTRACT WITH DEPARTMENT OF WAR

 

Eos will deploy its U.S.-made zinc battery system at a critical defense site, providing long-duration backup power for the Golden Dome missile-defense initiative.

Golden Dome Deployment

•	Eos received a multi-million-dollar Department of War contract, highlighted by President Trump at Sen. Dave McCormick’s defense summit.

•	Eos will first deploy its Z3 zinc-based energy-storage system as a prototype at a critical installation; the program can scale with defense needs.

•	The system targets resilient, uninterrupted power for military and critical infrastructure missions.

Toyota is using Nvidia’s AI stack to build safer L2+ vehicles, digital-twin factories, robotics, and AI-powered traffic systems.

Next-Gen Vehicles

•	Toyota’s next-gen vehicles will use Nvidia Drive AGX, safety-certified DriveOS, and the video-based Drive Hyperion platform for advanced L2+ driver assistance.

•	The goal: AI systems that can perceive, reason, and act safely in real-world driving conditions.

Factories & Cities

Morgan Stanley’s Tech Momentum Index is also seeing its sharpest breakdown on record, with its 17-day rate of change down 35%, the worst move in its 27-year history. Iran has asked Yemen’s Houthis to prepare attacks on Red Sea shipping if the U.S. strikes Iranian power infrastructure, threatening the last major Gulf oil-export alternative after Hormuz.

Red Sea Threat

•	Houthi forces have deployed missiles and drones near Bab el-Mandeb and await an order to begin attacks, a source close to the group says.

•	Iranian Revolutionary Guard personnel in Yemen would control any decision to close the strait, according to the source.

•	A Red Sea disruption would threaten shipping through Bab el-Mandeb, the gateway between the Gulf of Aden and Red Sea.

Energy Risk

SHARON AI $SHAZ SIGNS $1.32B AI CLOUD DEAL FOR NEW ZEALAND AI FACTORY



Sharon AI signed a five-year, $1.32B cloud-computing agreement with a global AI lab, with revenue expected to begin in H1 2027.

AI Factory Buildout

•	The contract supports Sharon AI’s first New Zealand AI Factory.

•	116 MW of its planned 132 MW capacity is already contracted.

•	Sharon AI expects to deploy more than 62,000 NVIDIA GPUs by mid-2027.

Why It Matters  

The deal provides major contracted demand ahead of the AI Factory launch, but execution now depends on delivering power, data-center capacity, and GPUs on schedule.

LYFT $LYFT EXPANDS CURB TAXI PARTNERSHIP TO NEW YORK CITY



Lyft riders in New York can now be matched with thousands of licensed taxis through the Lyft app, the company’s largest Curb integration yet.

New York Rollout

•	Lyft expands its Curb partnership to New York City, following launches in Los Angeles and San Francisco.

•	Thousands of licensed NYC taxis can now access Lyft’s rider network.

•	Riders keep Lyft’s standard pricing, safety tools, and in-app experience.

Why It Matters  

The move gives $LYFT more ride supply in its largest U.S. urban market while opening a new demand channel for taxi drivers.

ELI LILLY $LLY TO ACQUIRE ATAIBECKLEY $ATAI FOR UP TO $3.8B

Depression Drug Expansion

•	Lilly will pay $6.75 per share in cash, plus up to $2.50 per share in milestone-based CVRs, valuing the deal at up to $3.8B.

•	The acquisition adds BPL-003, an intranasal synthetic 5-MeO-DMT therapy for treatment-resistant depression with FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation.

•	BPL-003 is preparing for Phase 3 trials.

•	The deal is expected to close in Q3 2026, pending shareholder and regulatory approvals; it has no financing condition.

Why It Matters  

Lilly is buying into next-generation psychiatric treatments, adding a late-stage depression asset with potential for a faster regulatory path.

COMPASS PATHWAYS $CMPS ANALYSIS SUPPORTS COMP360’S DRUG-ONLY TREATMENT EFFECT

Phase 2 Treatment Support

•	Compass says its post-hoc Phase 2 analysis found COMP360 sessions used minimal, non-directive support, distinct from conventional psychotherapy.

•	Patients spent 78% of treatment sessions in silence; support focused on reassurance, validation, and physical presence.

•	Compass argues the clinical benefits seen with COMP360 psilocybin are therefore attributable to the drug treatment, not psychotherapy.

Why It Matters  

The analysis supports Compass’s effort to position COMP360 as a scalable, drug-led treatment for resistant depression rather than a therapy-dependent intervention.

Noetra AI Buildout

•	New venture Noetra Corp. will buy 27,500 Nvidia Rubin chips to build a homegrown foundation model for robotics.

•	Japan allocated ¥387.3B ($2.4B) through next March for Noetra’s large-scale data center.

•	SoftBank $SFTBY, Toyota-backed Preferred Networks $TM, and NEC are helping establish and operate Noetra.

Japan’s AI Strategy

•	Noetra plans its first model by March 2027, followed by regular updates; a robotics-focused foundation model is targeted within several years.

•	Japan aims to create a “third option” to U.S. and Chinese AI systems by combining sovereign AI with its industrial-robotics strengths.

SOUTH KOREA RAISES RATES TO 2.75%, FIRST HIKE IN OVER THREE YEARS

Inflation & Currency Pressure

•	The Bank of Korea raised its benchmark rate 25 bps to 2.75%, its first hike in more than three years.

•	Policymakers expect inflation to stay above the 2% target for an extended period.

•	A weaker won, rising household debt, and higher home prices added pressure to tighten policy.

•	Strong semiconductor exports and economic growth gave the central bank room to raise rates.

Why It Matters  

South Korea is prioritizing inflation, currency stability, and financial risks over further easing—even as higher rates increase pressure on households and housing.

UBER $UBER OFFERS €41.50/SHARE FOR DELIVERY HERO $DHER

Uber Takeover Offer

•	Uber submitted a voluntary €41.50-per-share offer for Delivery Hero, requiring acceptance of at least 50% plus one share.

•	Uber already holds nearly 25% of $DHER plus instruments covering almost 12% more; $PRX Prosus agreed to tender its roughly 17% stake.

•	Delivery Hero also agreed to sell businesses across 14 countries to SSW Partners for about €1.4B.

•	Both transactions target closing in H2 2027, pending regulatory approvals.

Why It Matters  

Uber has assembled substantial support for control of $DHER, while the SSW divestiture streamlines Delivery Hero ahead of a potential takeover.

HSBC: MEMORY PEAK CONCERNS PREMATURE AS AI, HBM DEMAND STAYS STRONG

AI Memory Demand

•	HSBC says the memory upcycle still has room to run, supported by strong AI demand, rising HBM pricing, and sustained cloud spending.

•	HSBC forecasts the HBM market will grow at a 70% CAGR through 2028, reaching $196B.

•	The bank reiterates Buy ratings on SK Hynix $000660, Samsung $005930, and Micron $MU.

Why It Matters  

HSBC sees AI servers and HBM as extending the memory cycle, pushing back on concerns that DRAM and NAND pricing is near a peak.
